purpose: Simulation-only diagnostic; no training or dataset augmentation
challenging_sampling: Uniform rejection sampling outside the closed nominal rectangle; one two-coordinate draw at a time
action_rule: float32(clip(clipped_PD_action + offset, -2, 2)); deduplicate exact executed float32 torques
continuation: One candidate action, then unchanged observation-based PD for the remaining 199 steps
acceptance: Distinct alternative, minimum raw margin >= 0, and both paired return gains strictly greater than threshold
bootstrap: Percentile 95% intervals from state-level resampling within nominal/challenging strata; equilibrium excluded
replay: Every distinct state-action rollout once; PD replays use the preserved evaluator
safety: All 201 raw states; strict margin < 0 violation; no early stopping; null first-crossing time denotes right censoring at 10 seconds
